notes: Page.evaluateHandle returns an isolated-world handle, and fails with Unsupported where a backend has no isolated worlds (isolatedWorlds: stock WebKit). Page.evaluateHandleInMainWorld returns one in the page's own world on every backend, so a page handle is available on all of them. A handle crosses only into calls in its own realm.

audit.scope: Public declarations and implementation inspected; capability comparison preserves the notes on waiting, errors and identity.
